meaning: sound like, seem from what you hear

english.note: Use 聽落 as the all-purpose way to say that someone or something seems a certain way from its sound.

exampleSentences.english: This song has quite a pleasant sound.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 sau2 go1 teng1 lok6 gei2 syu1 fuk6

english.note: Use this when the impression comes specifically from how something sounds or from what you hear.

exampleSentences.jyutping: teng1 lok6 nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6

english.note: Use this when judging how something sounds, especially whether it sounds true or plausible.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 teng1 lok6 gei2 ci5 zan1
